name: EX-18 Air Defence Exercise — 2 Days
description: 48-hour integrated air defence exercise covering air surveillance, threat tracking, engagement authority, missile battery operations, and coordination between ground-based air defence (GBAD), fighter aircraft, and command and control nodes. 24/7 operations. Suitable for air defence battalion and joint air defence exercises.

items.title: INITEX — Systems Online
items.description: Exercise commenced. All radar systems activated and reporting. Battery Alpha and Bravo in standby (RED) state. Air Operations Centre assumes control of exercise airspace. Engagement rules declared: Free Fire Zone above FL100, ROE briefed.

items.title: Radar Network Calibration
items.description: Surveillance radars conduct cross-calibration against known friendly aircraft tracks. Long-range search radar (60nm coverage), medium-range tracking radar, and fire control radar systems all verified. Common air picture established on AOC display. Data links tested.

items.title: INJECT: Unknown Track — ID Request
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Unknown radar track detected entering air defence identification zone (ADIZ). Track does not respond to IFF query. Speed: 450 knots, altitude FL080, heading 270. Scramble requested. Fighter pair dispatched for visual identification.

items.title: INJECT: Ballistic Missile Launch Detected
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Ballistic missile launch detected by early warning sensor. Trajectory calculated: impact point within defended area. Battery Alpha given track data and shoot authorisation. Time to intercept: 4 minutes 20 seconds. Launch command issued.

items.title: INJECT: Saturation Cruise Missile Attack
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Saturation attack — 12 cruise missiles launched simultaneously from 4 compass bearings. All batteries engage. Priority assignment: AOC allocates targets to Alpha and Bravo to avoid fratricide. Multiple simultaneous engagements. Reload procedures initiated. Ammunition status reported.

items.title: Post-Engagement Battle Damage Assessment
items.description: AOC compiles battle damage assessment: intercept probability, leakers (missiles through defence), ammunition expended, system availability after engagement. Report submitted to exercise headquarters.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: ENDEX declared. All systems to safe state. Missiles safe. Radars to standby. All teams stand down.

items.title: Air Defence AAR
items.description: Full AAR: track detection times, engagement authority decision speed, battery coordination, fratricide avoidance, saturation attack performance, ammunition management, BDA accuracy.
